description: Record the complete structural theorem on its current formal claim
command: ARGUS_SKILL_MATHLIB_WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE/.local/share/argus-skill/mathlib-v4.31.0 $WORKSPACE/argus-live-update/.venv/bin/python -m argus_skill.verticals.math.lean_evidence verify --project-root . --claim C118_STRUCTURAL_GAP research/structural_gap_certification/Main.lean --statement-fidelity research/structural_gap_certification/STATEMENT_FIDELITY.md > research/structural_gap_certification/official_bound_verify.json 2> research/structural_gap_certification/official_bound_verify.stderr.log; verify_code=$?; $WORKSPACE/argus-live-update/.venv/bin/python -m argus_skill.verticals.math.math_state check --project-root campaigns/9000118 > research/structural_gap_certification/bound_math_state_check.json; math_code=$?; $WORKSPACE/argus-live-update/.venv/bin/python -m argus_skill.verticals.math.proof_graph_check check --project-root campaigns/9000118 > research/structural_gap_certification/bound_proof_graph_check.log; graph_code=$?; printf "{\"project_root\":\"campaigns/9000118\",\"verify_exit_code\":%s,\"math_state_exit_code\":%s,\"proof_graph_check_exit_code\":%s}\n" "$verify_code" "$math_code" "$graph_code" > research/structural_gap_certification/bound_validation_exit_codes.json; test "$verify_code" -eq 0 && test "$math_code" -eq 0 && test "$graph_code" -eq 0
